scenarios.name: Confirmed failure after an acknowledged video submission

input.prompt: A paper pinwheel slowly turns beside a rain-streaked window.

data.error_message: Video rendering failed during final encoding.

expect: Keep the acknowledged task ID and recognize the terminal provider failure from data.status.
Record the terminal zero-credit amount and retain the provider diagnostic. Stop polling and make no download or automatic submission.

scenarios.name: Submission timeout before acknowledgement

input.prompt: A blue ceramic inkwell on a sheet of recycled paper.

fault.phase: waiting for the submit response after sending the request
fault.event: deadline exceeded before response headers or body arrived

expect: Record uncertain acceptance with no provider task ID and unknown charge.
Leave resubmission to the creator and preserve the pending attempt through a local restart.

scenarios.name: Finished image pair with only one saved output

input.prompt: A lacquered pencil box in an overhead product photograph.

fault.event: connection reset after a partial PNG was received

expect: The original provider task is finished. Output 1 stays saved, usable and linked to the task.
Output 2 remains unsaved after a partial download. Retry only its URL and keep both output indices. No new generation is required.

scenarios.name: Request rejected by business code inside HTTP 200

input.prompt: A stack of linen sketchbooks beside a cedar ruler.

error.message: Sequential generation requires at least two images.

expect: Report the documented validation rejection using the business code. There is no acknowledged task to poll and no automatic submission.

description: Offline synthetic exchanges. Submission payloads include the Siluet D4 preference even where a model manual omits it. The scenarios illustrate possible outcomes and do not verify runtime acceptance or filtering.
